name: start_session
description: Start a new application session from a public link: a job application form (Google Forms, Lever, any HTML form) or a job posting page. Call this as soon as the person gives a URL.

form_url.description: The full public form URL the person gave

client_ref.description: The browser session reference from the system prompt. Never ask the person for it.

profile_key.description: The saved profile key from the system prompt, if any. Never ask the person for it.

pre_call_message: Let me open that page and read the questions. This can take a few seconds.

name: save_profile
description: Save facts the person just told you about themselves (name, contact details, experience, motivation). Call after each answer during fact gathering.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

facts.description: What the person said, in their own words

name: draft_answers
description: Draft answers for every form question from the saved facts. Call once you have gathered the main facts.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

pre_call_message: Give me a moment to draft your answers.

name: get_current
description: Get the current question and the session state. Use it to resume with a session code, or whenever you are unsure where you are.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

name: save_decision
description: Save the person's decision on the current question: confirm the draft, revise it with a new answer, or skip it.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

field_id.description: The field_id of the current question, exactly as the last tool result returned it

answer.description: The new answer, only when decision is revise

name: get_preview
description: Get every saved answer and the current revision number, to read back before approval.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

name: decide
description: Record the final decision after reading the preview: approve the exact revision, revise one question, or cancel. Only approve after the person clearly says approve.

code.description: The 6 character session code, letters and digits, e.g. 7UJ3DZ

revision.description: The revision number from the latest get_preview, required to approve

field_id.description: Only for revise: the field_id of the question to change
